findings.finding: Jones five-viola arrangement is a selection of song No.2, with complete score 417794 and Viola 1–5 parts 417795–417799 listed. Audio 417800, 5:38, is credited to Steve’s Bedroom Band and explicitly labelled this five-viola arrangement.

Performer category gives no independent professional ensemble credits; no evidence of five distinct simultaneous performers was found. Treat known Steve’s Bedroom Band lead as multitrack, held under project policy. No professional ensemble claim is made.

recordingDecisions.reason: Real human multitrack is flagged for separate judgment; does not automatically satisfy ensemble-performance floor. No independent ensemble recording verified.
